capabilities: Render release-style timelines as a Bases view
Group notes by decade, year, quarter, month, or week
Switch between table, spine, and horizontal layouts
Color-code items and show cover thumbnails via properties
Collapse empty periods and jump between years
extras: Explicitly does not depend on Dataview; supports native Bases groupBy and standard Obsidian link navigation (click, Cmd/Ctrl-click, hover preview, right-click menu). Includes developer build and test instructions.
intentEvidence: This project is based on the original release timeline plugin by cakechaser
problem: Bases has no built-in way to display dated notes as a release-style timeline.

relations.evidence: This project is based on the original release timeline plugin by cakechaser

summary: Custom Obsidian Bases view that renders release-style timelines from date properties on filtered notes.
